newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slides, ARA inventory levels edge up.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slides, ARA inventory levels edge up.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices fell sharply on Thursday after yesterday's late drop in the U.S. and as heavy buying into the U.K. appeared to lighten up, traders said.

Industry sources said motor gasoline stocks held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area rose in the week ended today to 425,000-450,000 tonnes, despite departing cargoes, mostly to the U.K.
Stocks were up from the previous week's 400,000 tonnes and higher than the year-ago level of 375,000-400,000 tonnes, the sources said.
Eurograde barges traded late at $218 and $217, against $223/$225 on Wednesday and earlier trades at $220 and twice at $222.
Regular unleaded deals were scarce, with prices holding at about a $10 discount, at $207.
